1	# kumitate round 60 — frozen plan
2	
3	author: kumitate-shokunin (Kimi fresh L1)
4	base revision (before this plan): `ffbfe3cc38ff8eaa6375550b16472c90a006a179`
5	runtime identity: `Kimi fresh L1` (no model alias set in this session)
6	plan frozen before any data seat scored. Two claims, distinct axes.
7	
8	Lane axes: **operability + coverage**. Operability is the lowest non-retired axis
9	(score 9, terminal integer under the frozen `f_O` proxy). Coverage aggregate is retired at
10	saturation; the coverage move this round is a frontier-band advance. The stagnation nudge is
11	**not** active (round 59 entered the `cite-sources` capability row), so the lowest-axis
12	obligation stands and C1 works operability.
13	
14	## C1 — operability (lowest non-retired axis): capability acquisition `dispatch-evidence`
15	
16	**Surface.** The lane's own round-dispatch evidence. Today a report states its dispatch counts
17	from the launcher progress file by hand (the R58-V2 class: "a prepared spec is not a dispatch");
18	no committed gate reads that record. `scripts/wave-census.mjs` reads the *validated payload* and
19	the report files; it never reads `launcher-progress.tsv` or the actual dispatch registry
20	(`grep -n "launcher-progress\|dispatch-actual" scripts/wave-census.mjs` → 0 hits). This round adds
21	`scripts/dispatch-evidence.mjs`, contract `kumitate-dispatch-evidence-v1`:
22	
23	- reads `<root>/.ufo/waves/round-<N>/<wave>/launcher-progress.tsv` (the machine-written record:
24	  seat, pid, session id, exit code) and the sibling `dispatch-actual.json` (the summary a
25	  report quotes) and the seat report files;
26	- findings `PLAN_MISMATCH`, `SESSION_MISMATCH`, `REPORT_ABSENT`, `DEAD_SEAT_UNCREDITED`,
27	  `DEAD_MISMATCH`, `REGISTRY_MISMATCH`, `NOT_A_DISPATCH`, `EXPECT_MISMATCH`;
28	- `NOT_A_DISPATCH` is the class the round's own report must not commit: a registry whose members
29	  carry no session id is a *prepared spec*, never a dispatch;
30	- a dead seat (exit ≠ 0, no session id) is named and never credited;
31	- verdict `DISPATCH_EVIDENCE: CLEAN (seats=… sessions=… exit0=… reports=… dead=…)` exit 0,
32	  `DRIFT` exit 1, `FAIL-CLOSED` exit 2, usage 64;
33	- `--selftest` builds hermetic fixtures in `mkdtemp` and prints
34	  `DISPATCH_EVIDENCE_SELFTEST: PASS (n/n)` + `VERDICT: PASS`.
35	
36	**Frozen predicate (rule A60, ten checks).**
37	
38	`node .ufo/waves/round-60/probe/dispatch60-probe.mjs /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kumitate-shokunin <rev>`
39	prints `DISPATCH60: DISPATCH60_HELD held=10/10 checks=10 rev=<rev> rule=A60` and exits 0.
40	
41	| check | what it proves |
42	|---|---|
43	| A1 | `scripts/dispatch-evidence.mjs` exists at rev and is non-empty |
44	| A2 | its `--selftest` exits 0 and prints `DISPATCH_EVIDENCE_SELFTEST: PASS (n/n)` + `VERDICT: PASS` |
45	| A3 | the selftest names the six finding ids it must be able to produce |
46	| A4 | `SKILL.md` carries a gate-registry row for `dispatch-evidence` naming the entry command |
47	| A5 | `SKILL.md` carries a `## Verifiable checklist` task item naming the command |
48	| A6 | the `kumitate-gate-pins-v1` block pins `pin.dispatch-evidence` and the pin's sha256 equals the gate's bytes at rev |
49	| A7 | the `SCORECARD.md` capabilities table carries a `dispatch-evidence` row |
50	| A8 | `corpus/lessons/round-60.md` exists with `## Gate`, `## Mistakes` and the string `dispatch-evidence` |
51	| A9 | the gate registry grew to twenty and `SKILL.md`'s prose integer equals the gate-row count |
52	| A10 | the gate over this round's committed dispatch record prints `DISPATCH_EVIDENCE: CLEAN` with `seats=32`, exit 0 |
53	
54	**Kill rules.** (K1) the counter is judged on the frozen predicate, the frozen check count and
55	the frozen labels; a rule changed after a seat scored is not this claim's rule. (K2) a
56	do-nothing control that skips the claimed work must not reach `held=10/10`; the committed
57	drop-one mutant transcript must read `held=9/9 … checks-mismatch`. (K3) `held` must not be
58	reachable by a registry that carries no session ids. (K4) the count is taken from the committed
59	progress file, never from a prepared spec.
60	
61	**Expected progression (declared before data):** base `ffbfe3cc` → `held=0/10`; work commit →
62	`held=9/10` with exactly A10 MISS (the dispatch record is not committed until the wave
63	settles — by construction, and named in the report); measured commit → `held=10/10`.
64	
65	## C2 — coverage frontier band 4 (durable-execution and multi-agent failure research)
66	
67	**One theme.** Frontier band 4 of `PROVINCE.md`. Two entries adopted, seven rows mined, every
68	source re-opened **in this round** (access date 2026-10-24, quotes located by this lane).
69	
70	- `corpus/knowledge/durable-execution-and-fanout-primitives-2026-10-24.md` — S190 (Tail at
71	  Scale), S194 (Sagas). Satisfies the r59 flip for the fanout entry ("a later round whose one
72	  theme is band-4 primitives re-opens S190 and S194 and adopts it through the item-10 pipeline"):
73	  this round's one theme **is** band-4 primitives and both sources were re-opened here.
74	- `corpus/knowledge/durable-execution-failure-detection.md` — S126 (Temporal activity failure
75	  detection), S131 (Aliyun Managed Agents), S133 (Stop Means Stop), S134 (Where Does
76	  Exactly-Once Live), S135 (CyberAgent durable execution). Satisfies the r59 flip for the
77	  detection entry ("pin the S117/S126 group, then a later band-4 round may adopt the
78	  non-overlapping remainder"): the **S117/S126 duplicate-URL group is pinned in the same change**
79	  (`.ufo/pins/source-dupes.json`), and the row is scoped to what this round read — S134's title
80	  page only, no measured result claimed.
81	
82	**Frozen predicate (rule D60, six checks).**
83	
84	`node .ufo/waves/round-60/probe/doctrine60-probe.mjs /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kumitate-shokunin <rev>`
85	prints `DOCTRINE60: DOCTRINE60_HELD held=6/6 checks=6 rev=<rev> rule=D60` and exits 0.

87	| check | what it proves |
88	|---|---|
89	| F1 | both entries exist at rev; each head carries `verified-at: 2026-10-24` and `recheck:`; each first line cites its own ids and URLs |
90	| F2 | the seven rows exist in `corpus/SOURCES.md`, 11 cells, `status` `mined`, `opened` 2026-10-24, no literal or escaped pipe in any cell, `recheck` cell is an ISO date, `NNd` or a symbolic cadence (never prose) |
91	| F3 | each row's `used-by` names exactly the admitted entry that cites it and that path exists at rev |
92	| F4 | `.ufo/pins/source-captures.json` pins all seven and each capture blob's sha256 matches its pin |
93	| F5 | `.ufo/pins/source-dupes.json` pins the S117/S126 group and `source-dupes` at rev reads CLEAN |
94	| F6 | the lesson's `## Gate` records the two ADMITs and the two REJECTs with flips, and the collisions file names exactly S125/S127/S136 and none of the seven adopted ids |
95	
96	**Kill rules.** (K1) the seven ids are frozen before the append; a row appended under a different
97	id is not this claim's row. (K2) the byte-exact campaign rows must fail the census — the append
98	is a transformation, and a mutation control must show the transformation is load-bearing.
99	(K3) the validate-before-append must exit 0 on the scratch mirror. (K4) no adopted entry may
100	carry a source this round did not open.
101	
102	## Assimilation decisions (item 10, operator directive of 2026-10-24)
103	
104	- **Theme:** ONE — frontier band 4 (durable-execution and multi-agent failure research).
105	- **Adopted:** the two entries above, on seven rows (S126, S131, S133, S134, S135, S190, S194).
106	- **Rejected with reason + flip:** (1) `exactly-once-attribution.md` — its `S141` is the *same*
107	  arXiv 2609.29095 document the detection entry grounds as `S134`; one document under two ids
108	  in the staged set. Adopting both would add a duplicate-URL group and count one paper twice.
109	  *Flip:* a later band-4 round re-points the S134/S141 pair by document (one id per document),
110	  pins the group, and adopts the measured scope under a single id. (2)
111	  `multi-agent-coordinator-topologies.md` — a different theme (coordinator topology and its
112	  measured cost), not band 4's failure research. *Flip:* a later round whose one theme is
113	  coordinator topology re-opens S130 and S132.
114	- **Collision guard:** reg 126 ids, staged 147 ids, collisions 3 = `S125 S127 S136` — the ids
115	  round 59 already adopted from this same package, document-identical. None of the seven ids
116	  this round adopts is in the collision set, so no citation is re-pointed. The 0–3-leading-space
117	  extractor is used (a column-zero-only pattern false-greens an indented collision).
118	- **Quarantine:** the 9-row slice is re-derived at round time and hand-checked before any
119	  adoption; none of the nine is adopted.
120	- **considerthese:** `considerthese/2026-10-24.md` item 5 ("post-report commit check") is taken
121	  as QUALITY **Q51** — every lane commit between a round's base and its tip is named in that
122	  round's report's *Landed changes*, or an errata names it. The file is not edited. Items 1 and
123	  4 were taken in rounds 59 and 58; items 2, 3 and 6 are not taken this round.
124	
125	## Wave shape
126	
127	One v1 wave of **32 seats** (policy v1, band 32–64), validated before dispatch and dispatched
128	as one batched `kimi --output-format stream-json -p` call; the parent stays alive until every
129	seat settles. Role mix: executor 8, reviewer 8, critic 4, mutation-tester 4, scout 4, scribe 1,
130	connector 1, revenger 1, sentinel 1. Attack roles (reviewer + critic + mutation-tester) =
131	16/32 = 50 %. The canonical planner seat is held by the L1 — the validator rejects `planner` as a
132	swarm role — and the bounded planning data-walk rides the scout/connector/revenger items. A dead
133	seat is reported and never replaced.
134	
135	## Limits
136	
137	- The live sources census is not a D60 check: it already exits 0 at the base (the R58-V1 class).
138	- D60 F5 runs the lane's own `source-dupes` gate over the extracted tree, not the live fleet.
139	- A10 depends on the wave's own dispatch record; until that record is committed the arm is MISS
140	  by construction, which the expected progression above states.
141	- S194's full text is OCR-degraded in places (`compensatmg`, `1s` for `is`); the quote used is a
142	  contiguous substring of the captured bytes and the degradation is recorded in the lesson.
